statistical_interpretation: V7-A exhibited significantly higher paired faithfulness (V7-B < V7-A in 65.6% of pairs, Wilcoxon p = 1.55e-09). Marginal median advantage in V7-B (3.41 vs 1.39) is driven by heavy right-tail skew rather than paired dominance.
V7-B exhibited significantly lower completeness relative error (paired Wilcoxon p = 4.63e-05, V7-B error lower in 66.5% of pairs)
V7-B showed slight positive paired shift, not statistically significant at alpha=0.05 (Wilcoxon p = 0.277)
